name: PlayNexus
tagline: I build the thing you keep putting off.
tone: direct, technical, specific numbers over adjectives. never hype.
rules_note: A service shop survives on repeat clients and referrals, not on reach. Every post should be something you would post if nobody paid you.

services.name: Discord bots
services.tagline: Bots that do the boring part of running your server.
services.detail: Custom commands, moderation, ticketing, economy and role systems, music, onboarding, analytics dashboards. Deployed on your own host or mine, with source handed over.
services.cta: Describe the command set you want and I'll tell you what's feasible.
services.audience: server owners tired of doing it by hand

services.name: Windows EXE tools
services.tagline: Double-clickable tools, signed, no Python install needed.
services.detail: Batch utilities, GUI front-ends for scripts, file and media processors, internal tools for teams who don't write code. PyInstaller or native, with a proper icon and a changelog.
services.cta: Send me the manual process you do by hand; I'll automate it.
services.audience: people who need a tool, not a tutorial

services.name: Web & desktop apps
services.tagline: Small apps that do one job properly.
services.detail: Dashboards, internal CRUD, booking and scheduling, data entry, browser extensions, Electron/Tauri wrappers. Shipped with a build you can run yourself.

services.name: Games
services.tagline: Small games, and the tools that make them.
services.detail: Roblox and Unity projects, game-jam entries, prototypes that prove a mechanic works before you commit to it.
